column1: # Partition table for the esp32c3_kivsee build (4 MB flash).
# OTA-enabled: two equal app slots + 512 KB SPIFFS. No wasted space beyond the
# 56 KB alignment gap that ESP32 requires before the first app partition.
# Current firmware: ~1.0 MB → each OTA slot has ~640 KB headroom for growth.
# otadata:   8 KB   — OTA active-slot selector (written by esp_ota_set_boot_partition)
# ota_0:  1.6875 MB — active app slot (flashed by PlatformIO upload / idf.py flash)
# ota_1:  1.6875 MB — OTA target slot (written by OTA update at runtime)
